title: Participation, Contribution and Census Standards for the Cascade Group Dental & Vision Segments
content:
Every Employer Group Contract must show enough employee enrollment for its contribution type, and a contributory employer must carry a minimum share of the premium. The standards differ by size segment.

## Standards by segment

| Segment | Employer-paid participation minimum | Contributory participation minimum | Voluntary participation minimum | Voluntary minimum enrolled lives | Employer minimum contribution (contributory) | Census reporting interval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 2-19 | 100 percent | 75 percent | 25 percent | 3 | 50 percent | every 12 months |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 | 100 percent | 75 percent | 25 percent | 5 | 50 percent | every 12 months |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | 90 percent | 60 percent | 20 percent | 10 | 50 percent | every 12 months |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 100-249 | 90 percent | 50 percent | 15 percent | 15 | 25 percent | every 12 months |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | 85 percent | 40 percent | 10 percent | 25 | 25 percent | every 6 months |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 1000 Plus | 85 percent | 25 percent | 10 percent | 50 | 25 percent | every 3 months |

## Terms common to every segment

| Term | Value in all six segments |
|---|---|
| Employees waiving because they have other dental coverage excluded from the eligible count for participation | Yes |
| When participation is measured | At renewal, on the census then on file |
| Participation cure period | 60 calendar days after the renewal notice of a participation shortfall |

## Definitions

- **Employer-paid participation minimum**: the integer percent of eligible employees (excluding valid waivers) who must enroll when the employer pays all premium.
- **Contributory participation minimum**: the integer percent of eligible employees (excluding valid waivers) who must enroll on a contributory plan.
- **Voluntary participation minimum**: the integer percent of eligible employees who must enroll on a voluntary plan.
- **Voluntary minimum enrolled lives**: the fewest enrolled employees on a voluntary plan.
- **Waivers excluded (Yes)**: employees waiving because they have other dental coverage are excluded from the eligible count for participation.
- **Employer minimum contribution**: the integer percent of employee-only premium a contributory employer must pay.
- **When measured**: participation is measured at renewal on the census then on file.
- **Cure period**: the calendar days after the renewal notice of a participation shortfall within which the group may cure it before non-renewal.
- **Census reporting interval**: the months between required census reports.

## Contribution figures on both sides (hypothetical employer shares)

The employer minimum is a floor the contributory employer's share of employee-only premium must reach, so a share equal to the figure meets it.

| Segment | Hypothetical employer share of employee-only premium | Against the segment minimum |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | 50 percent | meets the 50 percent minimum |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | 45 percent | below the 50 percent minimum |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | 25 percent | meets the 25 percent minimum |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | 20 percent | below the 25 percent minimum |
